An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''captain'''<ref name="Novelization">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> served aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], during the Imperial [[occupation of Bespin]]<ref name="Episode V" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|V}} to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> Serving under [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], the Captain was present aboard the ''Executor''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] during the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer's]] fruitless pursuit of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] as it fled from the Imperial forces on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The Captain and Piett watched Vader with cold fear following the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], expecting to be [[Death/Legends|punished]] for their failure to capture the Rebel vessel, but the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] merely stalked off the bridge in defeated silence.<ref name="Episode V" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]] refers to this character as "Admiral Piett and his captain" in the novel's corresponding scene to the film.<ref name="Novelization" /> In the film, this scene also shows a subordinate standing behind Piett on the bridge whose uniform is adorned with [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|rank insignia]] denoting a captain.<ref name="Episode V" />
